title: Bratwurst Satay with Mild Chutney
description: A German twist on the classic Southeast Asian satay, featuring grilled bratwurst served with a sweet and spicy chutney.
instructions: 2. Thread bratwurst onto sausage skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
3. Brush the satay with oil and season with salt and pepper.
4. Grill the satay for 5-7 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
5. Meanwhile, warm the chutney and satay sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
6. Serve the grilled satay with the chutney and satay sauce for dipping.
7. Garnish with briny coleslaw and serve immediately.
